title: 01 / Agreement and project
description: Identify the agreement and its duration. Dates are entered explicitly; no agreement is signed by this form.

fields.name: awardTerms
fields.label: Award conditions and incorporated documents
fields.hint: Identify the award, version/date, restrictions, reporting, and required flow-down terms. Include the operative requirements or identify the documents both parties will receive. This draft does not replace a sponsor’s award instrument.

title: 02 / The parties
description: Use the actual legal entities and authorized signatories, not just trading names. Notice addresses appear in the agreement.

fields.name: providerName
fields.label: BIOracle contracting legal entity
fields.hint: Enter the full registered name of the entity signing for BIOracle.

fields.name: providerAddress
fields.label: BIOracle legal / notice address
fields.hint: Enter BIOracle's New Mexico street or mailing address. This address appears in the agreement header and notice section.
fields.default:
Center for Evolutionary and Theoretical Immunology
University of New Mexico
Albuquerque, NM 87131

fields.name: sponsorAddress
fields.label: Client or sponsor legal / notice address

title: 03 / Scope and delivery
description: Be specific enough for both parties to know what work is included, when it is due, and how it will be assessed.

fields.name: acceptance
fields.label: Acceptance criteria and review process
fields.hint: State the review deadline, objective criteria, rejection procedure, and any correction period.

title: 04 / Funding and allocation
description: Budget details are optional. Use a decimal point and no thousands separators. When all allocations and the total are supplied, they must balance.

fields.name: studentBudget
fields.label: Graduate-student support allocation
fields.hint: Enter an allocation if agreed; otherwise the PDF marks student support as to be agreed.

fields.name: paymentSchedule
fields.label: Funding and invoice schedule
fields.hint: Specify advance or milestone amounts and dates, invoice triggers, and any final reconciliation or refund arrangements.

title: 05 / Graduate-student support
description: Define the funded commitments and who is responsible for them. Do not enter bank details, tax identifiers, or other sensitive personal information.

fields.name: studentPlan
fields.label: Student roles, support, and payment plan
fields.hint: Include number of students or roles, period and rate of support, tuition/benefits if applicable, appointment or payment mechanism, payment dates, supervision, and how existing commitments are handled if funding is delayed.

title: 06 / Rights and legal terms
description: These provisions depend on the parties, jurisdiction, and sponsor. Specify the intended terms; obtain legal review before signature.

fields.name: disputeForum
fields.label: Courts / dispute venue
fields.hint: Identify the agreed court location and jurisdiction; this template uses negotiation followed by court proceedings.

fields.name: ipModel
fields.label: Ownership of project results
options: BIOracle entity owns results; client receives an internal-use license
Client owns project deliverables after full payment
Custom ownership and licensing terms below

fields.name: ipDetails
fields.label: IP, background materials, software, and license terms
fields.hint: Identify background IP, third-party restrictions, invention rights, and any agreed licenses. Missing terms remain to be agreed.

fields.name: publicationTerms
fields.label: Publication and academic-use terms
fields.hint: Specify publication rights, sponsor review periods, confidentiality or patent delays, and student thesis rights.

fields.name: dataTerms
fields.label: Data handling and security obligations
fields.hint: Describe permitted data, access, retention/deletion, incident notification, and applicable privacy or ethics requirements. Enter “No personal or regulated data permitted” if appropriate.

fields.name: liabilityCap
fields.label: Agreed aggregate liability cap
fields.hint: Enter an agreed positive cap in the project currency, or leave blank for a to-be-agreed placeholder.

fields.name: specialTerms
fields.label: Additional negotiated terms
fields.hint: Identify any clause being modified. Do not include signatures or sensitive credentials.
